page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What they are
steps.margin_note: Say what is inside the bone and where the air comes from. Two or three lines.
lines: Pneumatic bones are bones that hold air
The air sacs of the lungs send extensions into
They are found in the long bones and in the
steps.why: The cavities are not empty spaces but extensions of the air sacs, so the same arrangement that lightens the bone also carries air.
common_mistakes: Writing that the bones are hollow and empty. The cavities hold air from the air sacs.
Calling them weak bones. They are light but strong, because struts cross the cavities.
steps.memory_tip: Pneuma means air: an air bone is a bone with air inside.

steps.label: How they help
steps.margin_note: The second mark is the reason, not the name. Say weight reduction in so many words.

lines.text: Air inside the bone lowers the body weight

lines: Air weighs far less than bone, so the skeleton
The body weight of the bird is reduced, and
So pneumatic bones are a flight adaptation.
steps.why: Weight is the whole problem of flight, so every flight adaptation is explained by saying what it removes, and here it is the weight of solid bone.
common_mistakes: Writing that pneumatic bones help in breathing. Their marked use is weight reduction.
Saying they make the bird float. They reduce weight; they do not make the bird lighter than air.
steps.memory_tip: Less bone, more air, less weight, easier flight.

insider_note: Write the words reduce the body weight; examiners look for that phrase and not for a general sentence about flight.
